Sistem presensi dan penilaian kinerja un: Attendance and performance appraisal system for thousands of civil servants (ASN) — handling the simultaneous morning attendance spike, cross-agency staffing synchronization, and central database integration.
Sebagai flagship project, sistem ini men: As a flagship project, it includes a mobile app for daily attendance, a web app for dashboards and performance appraisal, and a centralized backend API that is the backbone of an integrated government systems ecosystem.
Presensi harian serentak ribuan ASN deng: Simultaneous daily attendance for thousands of civil servants with unstable-network tolerance
Integrasi dengan database pusat & ekosis: Integration with the central database & SIMPEG ecosystem
Eliminasi 100% error 504 di jam puncak: 100% of 504 errors eliminated at peak hours
18,000+ request/menit pada jam 07:00–07:: 18,000+ requests/minute between 07:00–07:30 when all civil servants check in at once — the legacy server collapsed and kept returning 504 errors.
Request presensi tidak lagi menulis lang: Attendance requests no longer write directly to MySQL. All ingestion is decoupled through Redis Stream so the morning surge is absorbed by the buffer.
Worker antrean memproses data secara bat: Queue workers process data in batches into the database. An in-memory buffer layer prevents a thundering herd on MySQL connections.
Koneksi seluler yang tidak stabil memicu: Unstable mobile connections trigger duplicate requests. Without a guard, a single attendance could be recorded twice — a classic race condition at the scale of thousands of devices.
Mutex Redis NX PX 10000 menjamin satu re: A Redis NX PX 10000 mutex guarantees each attendance request executes exactly once — idempotent against device retries.
Eliminasi 100% error 504 pada jam puncak: 100% of 504 errors eliminated at peak hours, SLA raised to 99.98%, and the system stays responsive with 40,000+ concurrent active users.
